description: F-026: the fixed parts of every CI job the engine renders. Change-controlled (H-0284): every pin and every flag rule here was reviewed; a change is a hygiene item. Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs, tools to a version and SHA-256 (S4.3).

flags.description: SR-6: a command argument that matches one of these makes the item recommend Reject. Matched case-insensitively against each argument, and against each word of an argument that holds spaces.

risks.common: Runs on GitHub's Linux runners for pull requests to main and pushes to main, with a read-only token and no secrets. Actions and tools are pinned. The new check counts toward merges only once you mark it required on GitHub.
risks.test-command: Runs the install and test commands shown, which come from the test engineer. They run the repo's own test code, as CI already does for every pull request.
risks.coverage: As a test command, then fails when line coverage in the report is below the minimum.
risks.gitleaks: Scans the repo's full git history for secrets with gitleaks; a finding fails the check and shows the file and line, with the secret redacted.
risks.semgrep: Runs Semgrep Community Edition with the listed configs. Registry rules are fetched at run time and never copied into the repo; metrics are off.
risks.osv-scanner: Scans the repo's lockfiles for known vulnerabilities with OSV-Scanner; any finding fails the check.
risks.schedule: Also runs weekly on main, so it uses Actions minutes even when nothing changes (billed on private repos).
